faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Professor position at Aligarh Muslim University is 09-08-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Assistant Professor post in the Aligarh Muslim University recruitment 2026. This single opening is for the Chinese language specialization.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must possess a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in Chinese, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the AMU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General and OBC category candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, while SC/ST candidates also need to pay Rs. 500/-. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor role at AMU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor position at Aligarh Muslim University primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and then called for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Professor position at Aligarh Muslim University is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed term as per the university's policy.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the Aligarh Muslim University Assistant Professor recruitment can be found on the university's official website. A direct link to the PDF is also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, at the Aligarh Muslim University campus.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Specific age limit details and any applicable relaxations are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for comprehensive information on age criteria.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of Aligarh Muslim University or through the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section. Ensure all details are filled correctly and the application is submitted before the last date.
